fullPassage:
Recently, an artist used an artificial intelligence (AI) system to create the image above for an art contest. The image won first place in the digital arts category. This led to a controversy in the art community. Some people complained that the artist simply provided the system with basic instructions and let it do all the work. They felt this wasn't fair to the rest of the artists in the contest. However, there were also people who were excited by the potential of AI. Today, there are numerous AI programs that can create various forms of art including images, songs, and novels.

AI image generators create images based on our text requests. They do this by copying other images that were created by humans. The generators have the ability to analyze millions of images and their corresponding descriptions. This allows them to create works of art in a short time based on the provided instructions.

Moreover, AI programs can mix the styles of existing images upon request. For example, you can blend a photograph of a cat with Johannes Vermeer's Girl with a Pearl Earring. These two images have a few differences. However, the overall design, the eyes, and the scarf around the head are clearly based on Vermeer's painting. A simple request was enough to create this complex and detailed image.

AI programs may lead to changes not only in the art world but also in the music industry. These programs are already able to compose songs, and they give you many options. For example, you can choose the style and key, such as C major or A minor. You can also set how long the song will be. Once you've entered the information, the program will produce a song that you can edit or use as it is. Furthermore, computer-generated imagery (commonly known as CGI) has opened up new possibilities in the music industry. Virtual influencers with extremely realistic faces, bodies, and voices have already released several songs. Some of them have many followers on social media, just like human singers. These types of virtual musicians are able to speak and move realistically with the help of their human creators.

Many AI programs are open to the public, which means they can be used freely and conveniently. However, these programs have sparked a debate over their impact on humans. Since AI has the potential to learn skills and perform them better than humans, some people view it as a threat. They worry that AI will replace humans in more and more areas. There are also concerns that AI may imitate the styles of human artists without their consent. On the other hand, others think that AI cannot exceed human imagination and that it is still dependent on human assistance. This is because the data that AI uses can have flaws or limitations. A dependence on imperfect data with little diversity eventually limits the output of AI programs. Human imagination, on the other hand, has no limits or boundaries.

What kind of future do you think lies ahead of us? Will more people use AI programs to boost their creativity and productivity? Or will people grow tired of the limitations of AI tools? AI provides many benefits and new opportunities. What we need to do is figure out how to use AI tools ethically and think about how humans and AI can collaborate.

questions.passage: Recently, an artist used an artificial intelligence (AI) system to create the image above for an art contest. The image won first place in the digital arts category. This led to a (A)[controversy / celebration] in the art community. Some people complained that the artist simply provided the system with basic instructions and let it do all the work. They felt this wasn't (B)[fair / profitable] to the rest of the artists in the contest. However, there were also people who were (C)[excited / frightened] by the potential of AI.
questions.stem: 위 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미술계에서 논란으로 이어졌다. 대회의 나머지 화가들에게 공평하지 않다고 느꼈다. AI의 잠재력에 들뜬 사람들도 있었다.
det.analysis:
✅ (A) controversy(논란): 불평과 함께 나온 반응. celebration(축하)은 부적합.
✅ (B) fair(공평한): wasn't fair. profitable(수익성 있는)은 맥락과 무관.
✅ (C) excited(들뜬): AI 잠재력에 긍정적. frightened(겁먹은)은 반대.
det.tip: controversy: 논란 / fair: 공평한 / potential: 잠재력

questions.passage: Many AI programs are open to the public, which means they can be used freely and (A)[conveniently / reluctantly]. However, these programs have sparked a debate over their (B)[impact / absence] on humans. Since AI has the potential to learn skills and perform them better than humans, some people view it as a (C)[threat / blessing].
questions.stem: 위 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 편리하게 이용 가능. 인간에게 미치는 영향에 관한 논쟁. 위협으로 보는 사람들.
det.analysis:
✅ (A) conveniently: 자유롭고 '편리하게'. reluctantly(마지못해)는 반대.
✅ (B) impact: '영향'. absence(부재)는 무관.
✅ (C) threat: '위협'. blessing(축복)은 반대.
det.tip: conveniently(편리하게) / impact on(~에 대한 영향) / view as a threat(위협으로 보다)

questions.passage: Others think that AI cannot (A)[exceed / match] human imagination and that it is still (B)[dependent / independent] on human assistance. This is because the data that AI uses can have flaws or (C)[limitations / advantages]. A dependence on imperfect data with little diversity eventually limits the output of AI programs.
questions.stem: 위 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI는 인간 상상력을 뛰어넘을 수 없으며 인간 도움에 의존한다. 데이터에 결함이나 한계가 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ (A) exceed: 상상력을 '뛰어넘다'. match(맞먹다)보다 정확.
✅ (B) dependent: 인간에 '의존'. independent(독립적)은 반대.
✅ (C) limitations: '한계'. advantages(장점)는 반대.
det.tip: exceed(뛰어넘다) / dependent on(~에 의존하는) / flaws or limitations(결함이나 한계)

questions.passage: AI image generators create images based on our text ①<u>requests</u>. They do this by copying other images that were created by humans. The generators have the ability to ②<u>analyze</u> millions of images and their corresponding descriptions. This allows them to create works of art in a ③<u>long</u> time based on the ④<u>provided</u> instructions.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 수백만 개의 그림을 ②분석할 능력. ③긴 시간 안에 작품을 만들어 낸다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②④ 원문 그대로.
❌ ③ long(긴) → 원문은 short(짧은). AI의 장점은 '짧은 시간'에 작품을 만드는 것.
det.tip: in a short time(짧은 시간에) ↔ in a long time(긴 시간에)

questions.passage: AI programs may lead to changes not only in the art world but also in the music industry. These programs are already able to ①<u>compose</u> songs, and they give you many options. Once you've entered the information, the program will ②<u>produce</u> a song that you can edit or use as it is. Virtual influencers with extremely ③<u>realistic</u> faces, bodies, and voices have already released several songs. These types of virtual musicians are able to speak and move realistically with the help of their human ④<u>competitors</u>.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 노래를 ①작곡. 노래를 ②제작. ③사실적인 얼굴. 인간 ④경쟁자들의 도움.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②③ 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ competitors(경쟁자) → 원문은 creators(창작자). 가상 음악가들을 만든 '창작자'.
det.tip: creators(창작자) ↔ competitors(경쟁자) / with the help of their human creators

questions.passage: However, these programs have sparked a debate over their ①<u>impact</u> on humans. Since AI has the potential to learn skills and perform them better than humans, some people view it as a ②<u>threat</u>. They worry that AI will ③<u>replace</u> humans in more and more areas. On the other hand, others think that AI cannot exceed human imagination and that it is still ④<u>independent</u> of human assistance.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 인간에 대한 ①영향. ②위협으로 본다. 인간을 ③대체. 인간 도움에 ④독립적이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①②③ 원문 그대로.
❌ ④ independent(독립적인) → 원문은 dependent(의존하는). AI는 인간 도움에 '의존'한다.
⚠️ 함정: independent는 긍정적으로 들리지만, AI가 인간에 '의존'한다는 게 원문 논지.
det.tip: dependent on(~에 의존하는) ↔ independent of(~에 독립적인)

❌ ① celebration(축하): 불평 맥락과 반대.
❌ ② agreement(합의): 논란의 반대.
❌ ④ partnership(파트너십): 무관.
det.tip: controversy: 논란, 논쟁 / lead to a controversy: 논란으로 이어지다

det.korean: 수백만 개의 그림과 그에 상응하는 설명을 분석.
det.analysis:
✅ ② corresponding: '상응하는'. 그림에 맞는 설명.
❌ ① unrelated(무관한): 반대.
❌ ③ outdated(구식의): 무관.
❌ ④ imaginary(상상의): 부적합.
det.tip: corresponding: 상응하는, 일치하는 / corresponding descriptions: 해당 설명

questions.stem: 위 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: AI 도구를 윤리적으로 사용하는 방법을 알아내야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ ethically: '윤리적으로'. 동의 없이 모방하는 문제 등 윤리적 고려 필요.
❌ ① carelessly(부주의하게): 반대.
❌ ② aggressively(공격적으로): 부적합.
❌ ④ secretly(비밀리에): 부적합.
det.tip: ethically: 윤리적으로 / collaborate: 협력하다

questions.passage: Today, there are <u>numerous</u> AI programs that can create various forms of art including images, songs, and novels.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>numerous</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 많은 AI 프로그램들이 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② many: numerous와 동의어.
❌ ① few(적은): 반대.
❌ ③ rare(드문): 반대.
❌ ④ limited(제한된): 반대.
det.tip: numerous = many = a large number of (수많은)

questions.passage: However, these programs have <u>sparked</u> a debate over their impact on humans.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>sparked</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 이러한 프로그램들은 논쟁을 불러일으켰다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② triggered: sparked와 동의어. '촉발하다'.
❌ ① resolved(해결하다): 반대.
❌ ③ prevented(방지하다): 반대.
❌ ④ ignored(무시하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: spark = trigger = provoke (촉발하다, 불러일으키다)

questions.passage: They worry that AI will <u>replace</u> humans in more and more areas.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>replace</u>와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: AI가 인간을 대체할 것이라 걱정.
det.analysis:
✅ ② substitute: replace와 동의어.
❌ ① assist(도와주다): 대체가 아닌 보조.
❌ ③ support(지원하다): 대체가 아님.
❌ ④ employ(고용하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: replace = substitute = take the place of (대체하다)

questions.passage: A dependence on <u>imperfect</u> data with little diversity eventually limits the output of AI programs.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>imperfect</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 불완전한 정보에의 의존.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ flawless(결함 없는, 완벽한): imperfect의 반의어.
❌ ① flawed(결함 있는): 동의어.
❌ ② defective(결함 있는): 동의어.
❌ ④ incomplete(불완전한): 동의어.
det.tip: imperfect = flawed = defective (불완전한) ↔ flawless = perfect (완벽한)

questions.passage: AI cannot <u>exceed</u> human imagination and it is still dependent on human assistance.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 <u>exceed</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: AI는 인간 상상력을 뛰어넘을 수 없다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ fall short of(~에 미치지 못하다): exceed의 반의어.
❌ ① surpass(능가하다): 동의어.
❌ ② outperform(더 잘하다): 동의어.
❌ ④ go beyond(넘어서다): 동의어.
det.tip: exceed = surpass = outperform (뛰어넘다) ↔ fall short of (~에 미치지 못하다)

questions.passage:
(A) AI image generators create images based on our text requests. They do this by copying other images that were created by humans. This allows them to create works of <u>art</u> in a short time.

(B) Negotiation is an <u>art</u> that requires patience and understanding of both sides.
questions.stem: 위 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 art의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) 짧은 시간에 예술 작품을 만들어 낸다. (B) 협상은 인내와 양측의 이해를 필요로 하는 기술/능력이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ① (A) works of art: 예술 작품. (B) an art: 기술, 능력.
det.tip: art의 다의어: ① 예술, 미술 (works of art) ② 기술, 능력 (the art of negotiation)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"to work jointly with others on a shared task or project"

det.korean: "공유된 과업이나 프로젝트에서 다른 사람들과 함께 일하다" → 협력하다
det.analysis:
✅ ② collaborate(협력하다): 정의와 일치.
❌ ① compete(경쟁하다): 반대.
❌ ③ complain(불평하다): 다른 의미.
❌ ④ consume(소비하다): 다른 의미.
det.tip: collaborate: 협력하다 = cooperate = work together

det.korean: 인간 예술가의 동의 없이 화풍을 모방할지도 모른다.
det.analysis: ✅ consent: 변형 불필요. 명사 그대로. without their consent(동의 없이).
det.tip: consent: 동의, 승낙 / without consent: 동의 없이

questions.passage: AI provides many benefits and new opportunities. What we need to do is figure out how to use AI tools __________ (ethic) and think about how humans and AI can collaborate.

det.korean: AI 도구를 윤리적으로 사용하는 방법을 알아내야 한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ethically: ethic(명사) → ethical(형용사) → ethically(부사). 동사 use를 수식하는 부사.
det.tip: ethic(n. 윤리) → ethical(adj. 윤리적인) → ethically(adv. 윤리적으로)

det.analysis:

det.korean: 인간과 AI가 어떻게 협력할 수 있을지 생각해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② collaborate: 원문 그대로. 윤리적 사용 + 협력.
